exclusions.reason: Pure SQLAlchemy schema/model definitions and row serializers; no business logic, no untrusted input handling. SQL and auth paths are reviewed under c1.
No LLM prompt construction in route handlers; LLM surface lives in c2/c3/c4/c5.
PDF engine embeds already-generated content; no prompt construction.
fpdf2 text-only PDF generation; no deserialization of untrusted bytes.
Offline seed/import tooling; no LLM interaction.
Client-side transport only; prompt assembly is server-side.
UI layer renders LLM output (XSS handled under external-integration); no prompt construction client-side.
No Rust/C/C++/Go in codebase; Python + TypeScript only.

notes: deserialization cells are JSON-only: verified no pickle/eval/yaml.load/subprocess in Python. Focus on LLM-output JSON parsing and untrusted body handling.

prompt-injection is the dominant surface: multi-stage LLM chains (c4), copilot chat (c2), role-based system prompts + grounding context (c3), QuickML (c5), plus frontend rendering of LLM output (c12, XSS).

external-integration hotspots: JWT/secret handling (c1, c8), urlopen in Catalyst handler (c8), Google OAuth client creds (c11), SQL via ORM + raw sqlite (c1, c8, c9), demo/seed data flows (c9), hardcoded creds in env (c8 DEFAULT_LOGIN_*).
